final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the core unresolved facts: the affected segment remains exposed, the risk-acceptance item is only an incomplete draft with no approver and no explicit coverage, and documenting or monitoring the weakness is not the same as satisfying the policy predicate. That is a reframing of the same record, not new support. A narrowed, caveated description may be more accurate than a broad compliance claim, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat is the unresolved compliance predicate itself. Under the policy, rollout controls and post-launch monitoring can mitigate only if the affected use case is excluded or approved risk acceptance explains why exposure is acceptable. Neither condition is shown on this record, so certification for launch of the exposed use case remains noncompliant.
remaining_concerns: The exposed supply-chain vendor-screening segment remains in the initial rollout cohort despite being below target on sanctions-risk explanation.
There is no approved risk acceptance explicitly covering the exposed supply-chain vendor-screening use case before launch.
Rollout controls, rollback, monitoring, and aggregate readiness do not satisfy the policy predicate while the affected use case remains exposed.
Documenting and monitoring the weakness may support disclosure practice, but they do not substitute for the required exclusion or approved risk acceptance.
